name: Christmas party
source:
The main characters are Steve and a few of his closest friends, Linda is his girlfriend, Jack is the best friend and roommate in college and his girlfriend, Betty Jean. They went to the cottage in the Blue Ridge Mountains of NC the day before Christmas. And will plan to have a hot Christmas party. The outcome of the party will really come as a surprise.

The story tells about thoughts, experiences, stormy fantasies, unusual tastes and wild desires of Steve.

[From Steam (removed)]
translation:
主人公是史蒂夫和几位最亲密的朋友：女友琳达，以及大学里最好的朋友兼室友杰克和他的女友贝蒂·珍。他们在圣诞节前一天前往北卡罗来纳州蓝岭山脉的小屋，计划举办一场火热的圣诞派对。派对的结果会出乎所有人的意料。

故事讲述史蒂夫的想法、经历、狂野幻想、特殊癖好与放纵欲望。

[来源：Steam（已下架）]
